title: 12 — motion graphics, English · «One shape tells the whole idea»
audience: marketing teams and agencies that make videos for clients
category_noun: a tool that makes the video
alternative: a shoot day, or stock footage
mechanism: it turns the idea into shapes that move and become one another, with no camera
claim: explain any idea in a video without filming anything
repeat_sentence: You don't need a camera to explain an idea in a video — the tool turns it into motion

hook.visual: a dot grows into a circle in the first second
hook.written: the line is on screen from the first frame

jargon.plain: the tool's name, inside the button in the last frame

beats.job: the hook — the absence is the surprise
beats.shows: a dot grows into a circle
establishes: this video has no filming in it

beats.job: the category, and the cost it removes
says: A tool that makes video from an idea — no shoot day.
beats.shows: the circle stretches into a long bar — a whole day — then folds into one small block
needs: this video has no filming in it
establishes: a tool makes the video from an idea

says: Got a number? Watch it grow.
beats.shows: the block rises into a column, the number counts to 100%
needs: a tool makes the video from an idea
establishes: a number can be explained by motion

says: Got steps? They build in order.
beats.shows: the column splits into three steps, rising one after another, left to right
needs: a number can be explained by motion
establishes: steps can be explained by motion

beats.shows: the steps become the one circle again — the shape the video started with
needs: steps can be explained by motion
establishes: any idea can be explained without filming

beats.shows: the circle opens into a button carrying the tool's name
